defaultWallHeightMm.title: Default wall height
defaultWallHeightMm.description: New walls start at this height. Empty: 2.40 m.

elevationMm.title: Elevation
elevationMm.description: Height of this floor's finished floor in the house.

riseToRoof.title: Rise to roof
riseToRoof.description: Under a roof whose walls rise, this wall extends up to the roof's underside. Off: it keeps its own height (the roof still cuts it).

depthMm.title: Depth
depthMm.description: Positive sticks out of the wall, negative goes into it, zero is flat

cutFloorAbove.title: Cut floor above
cutFloorAbove.description: Cuts the floor the stair reaches, and any floor it passes through

cutFloorBelow.title: Cut floor below
cutFloorBelow.description: Cuts the floor the stair stands on, for a stair going down

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Off never plays; in the Home Assistant viewer a binding decides when it runs

offsetMm.title: Offset
offsetMm.description: From the middle of the object's top (Up) or front (Forward), in the object's own axes

facingDeg.title: Facing
facingDeg.description: 0° shines down, 90° left of the heading, 180° up, 270° right

cutsWalls.title: Cuts walls
cutsWalls.description: The roof's underside is the height limit of this floor's walls.

wallsRise.title: Walls rise
wallsRise.description: Walls under the roof extend up to its underside (gable ends fill to the ridge).

eaveHeightMm.title: Eave height
eaveHeightMm.description: The roof's base above the floor; point heights are measured from it.

stepMm.title: Step height
stepMm.description: How much higher the raised side is along the line.
